tests.title: parses n=2|3 with the native default and shorthand, and refuses other values, enable= and unknown options
applies epx2 and epx3 neighbour rules with edge clamping into owned tight planes
refuses formats, budgets, malformed strides, bad time bases and cancellation explicitly
plans n-times geometry on every path, keeps the timed sample aspect ratio and bounds the scaled output
matches native epx2 and epx3 pixels across packed RGBA formats, sizes and structured patterns
matches native linear and graph epx plans with scalar conversions around the packed RGBA stage
matches native replayed epx streams with branches and joins frame by frame
matches native epx CLI rawvideo and framecrc on the linear, graph, actor and timed paths
refuses epx output above maxFrameBytes and options native rejects before any output is opened
(whole file, unchanged; runs epx examples on all five paths)

details: 320 kernel frames (raw bytes) vs native -vf epx=n=N: 4 formats x n{2,3} x sizes 1x1,3x3,5x4,13x9 x 10 patterns; 192 differ from plain replication
200 linear plans + 200 frame-graph plans (raw bytes) vs native -cpuflags 0 -vf, sources rgba/abgr/rgb24/gray/yuv420p, 5 chains, 4 targets
16 replay streams (raw bytes, 5 frames each, timestamps) vs native -filter_complex
152 CLI outputs (rawvideo and framecrc) via createMediaBackend (-vf and -filter_complex) and timed backend schedulers producer (actor), activation and pull (timed)
12 refusals: 4 native-rejected option forms x media/actor/timed backends, no output opened; plus maxFrameBytes refusal on the scaled output

unsupported: expression-valued or non-decimal n (e.g. n=1+1, n=0x2, n=2.0)
enable= (native has no timeline either), generic filter-context options such as threads, runtime commands
timed-backend inputs that need pixel conversion before epx (only packed RGBA sources compared on actor/timed)
slice threading (results are identical; whole-frame kernel)

notes: No shared edit beyond the two registry lines was needed.
Setup durations: submodule 46s, npm ci 9s, reference:build 198s; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 64s, baseline unit suite 89s.
Baseline and final unit failures are identical: FLAC artifact tests (downloads.xiph.org blocked) and 10 resample-checkpoint macOS digests.
Mutation check: removing 'timed' or 'actor' from the epx flags makes the CLI differential test fail on the pull or producer scheduler.
vf_epx.c has no individual copyright line; NOTICE-EPX credits the FFmpeg developers and the original contributor.
